name: AI: draft a Social Poster post from a topic for review

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps you turn a topic into a finished post text and save it in Social Poster as a draft for review. You enter the topic and optional notes in a form. The workflow then loads your team’s brand and network context from Social Poster and sends both to OpenAI. The model writes only the caption; it does not publish anything. Social Poster creates the draft and then validates it against the rules of the chosen network. You review the draft in Social Poster and schedule or edit it there. This workflow does not publish and does not confirm a schedule.

### Setup
This template uses the unverified community node `n8n-nodes-social-poster` (tested with version 0.1.1). It runs on self-hosted n8n only, not on n8n Cloud. Install it under Settings → Community Nodes → Install, package name `n8n-nodes-social-poster`. Guide: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
Create credentials for “Social Poster API” and OpenAI. You create the Social Poster key under the account menu → AI access → API key for n8n. Base URL: `https://app.social-poster.io`.
In “Settings”, enter your account reference (`acc_…`). Select both credentials on the nodes. Open the form with “Test workflow”, submit a topic, and check the new draft in Social Poster. If the text looks empty, inspect the OpenAI node output and adjust the expression on the draft node.

### Customization
You can change the model, language or tone in the OpenAI prompt. You can also start from a schedule or a spreadsheet instead of the form. If draft validation fails, the draft still exists in Social Poster; the error explains what the network did not accept.

## Start from the form
You enter the topic and optional notes. The account reference is set in “Settings”.

## Context and draft
First the workflow loads brand context from Social Poster, then OpenAI writes the caption.

## No publishing
The workflow only creates and validates a draft. You schedule and approve it in Social Poster.

values.content:
=You write a social media post for Social Poster. Return only the finished post text, with no quotation marks, no heading such as “Post:”, and no explanation.

Use the following brand and network context from Social Poster where it is available:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Topic:
{{ $('Settings').item.json.Topic }}

Additional notes from the person using this workflow:
{{ $('Settings').item.json.Notes || 'No further notes.' }}

Rules:
- Write in the language of the topic, typically German, in a clear, natural “Du” tone if the topic is German.
- Keep the text short enough for common networks, usually under 1,800 characters.
- Do not invent facts, offers or numbers that are not in the topic or the notes.
- Do not add a list of hashtags unless the notes ask for them.
